name: INARI
recent: Inari Amertron 公布 2026 财年第一季度业绩，净利按年增长 18.5% 至约 6100 万令吉，并宣布每股 1.5 仙的首次中期股息。同期，公司因雇员认购 ESOS 期权而多次发行新股。此外，雇员公积金局（EPF）和公务员退休基金局（KWAP）在 10 月至 11 月间频繁申报股权变动。
notable: 公布 2026 财年第一季度业绩，净利按年增长 18.5% 至约 6100 万令吉。
宣布每股 1.5 仙的首次中期股息，除权日为 2026 年 12 月 9 日。
因雇员行使 ESOS 期权，分别于 2026 年 10 月 28 日和 11 月 13 日发行新股上市。
risks: 雇员公积金局（EPF）和公务员退休基金局（KWAP）在近期多次申报股权变动。
公司因 ESOS 期权行使而持续发行新股，导致股本逐步扩大。
earnings: 最近一季（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收为 2.889 亿令吉，按季增长 8.7%，但按年下降 5.8%；净利为 615 万令吉，净利率 2.1%，净利按季下降 78.0%，按年下降 87.5%。

recent_en: Inari Amertron reported a 18.5% year-on-year rise in 1Q net profit to about RM61 million and declared a first interim dividend of 1.5 sen per share. During the period, the company issued new shares multiple times due to ESOS option exercises. In addition, EPF and KWAP frequently reported changes in their shareholdings between October and November.
notable_en: Announced 1Q FY2026 results with net profit up 18.5% year-on-year to about RM61 million.
Declared a first interim dividend of 1.5 sen per share, with ex-date on 9 December 2026.
Listed new shares on 28 October 2026 and 13 November 2026 arising from ESOS option exercises.
risks_en: EPF and KWAP reported multiple changes in their shareholdings recently.
The company continues to issue new shares from ESOS option exercises, gradually enlarging its share base.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM288.9 million, up 8.7% QoQ but down 5.8% YoY; net income was RM6.15 million with a net margin of 2.1%, down 78.0% QoQ and 87.5% YoY.
